surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites
evidence: In a previous study we found that alternate reactions of bismuth tris(bis(trimethylsilyl)amide) Bi(N(SiMe3)2)3 and H2O can be used to mix bismuth into other oxides, such as Ta2O5 and SrTa2O6. However, the growth of binary Bi2O3 was observed to be difficult compared to the mixed oxides.
